name: micro-frontends-pedidos
description: Sistema de pedidos com Micro Frontends usando Webpack Module Federation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n cardapio,pedido,container -c green,yellow,blue "npm run dev -w micro-cardapio" "npm run dev -w micro-pedido" "npm run dev -w container"
scripts.start: concurrently -n cardapio,pedido,container -c green,yellow,blue "npm run start -w micro-cardapio" "npm run start -w micro-pedido" "npm run start -w container"
